topics.title: Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) & Target Account Tiering
topics.objective: Segment high-value enterprise accounts based on firmographics, technographics, and revenue thresholds.
topics.example: Tier 1: 50 Named Accounts (> $100M ARR); Tier 2: 250 Industry Verticals ($20M - $100M ARR)
topics.exercise: Develop an ICP scorecard evaluating prospective accounts across technical stack and employee headcount.

topics.title: Third-Party Intent Data & Surge Signal Detection
topics.objective: Detect active buying cycles by monitoring intent surges (Bombora, G2, 6sense) on target topics.
topics.example: IntentSurge: Account 'Acme Corp' researching 'Kubernetes Security' with score 88/100
topics.exercise: Build an automated alert triggering SDR outreach when a Tier 1 account shows 3 concurrent intent spikes.

topics.title: Hyper-Personalized Content Assets & Executive Landing Pages
topics.objective: Craft bespoke executive briefs, ROI calculators, and personalized landing experiences per account.
topics.example: Custom Brief: 'Accelerating Digital Transformation for [TargetCompany]'s Engineering Team'
topics.exercise: Design a personalized landing page template dynamically injecting target company branding and industry metrics.

topics.title: Multi-Channel Orchestration: LinkedIn Ads, Direct Mail & SDR cadences
topics.objective: Coordinate touchpoints across paid social, executive gift mailers, and personalized sales sequences.
topics.example: Cadence: Day 1: LinkedIn Ad Impression -> Day 3: Custom Whitepaper Mailer -> Day 7: Exec SDR Email
topics.exercise: Design a 30-day multi-touch campaign cadence engaging key buying committee stakeholders (CTO, VP Eng).

topics.title: Account-Level Engagement Scoring & Multi-Touch Attribution
topics.objective: Measure pipeline velocity, committee coverage, and influenced ARR using W-shaped attribution models.
topics.exercise: Construct an account health dashboard tracking engagement scores and pipeline conversion rates.
